description: HesabYar Phase 5 — Foundation (5الف) of the store-connectivity / banking / gateway / cheque architecture (ADR 0003, accepted 2026-11-17). Per the phased design (hesabyar-reference/phased-design-checklist-2026-11-17.md §1.2, 5الف): event platform (F1), Tryton modules (F2), registries + policy gate (F3), review-queue skeleton (F4) — all four streams run IN PARALLEL in isolated worktrees. Builds on branch ralph/phase-4 (Phase 4 complete 5/5: standards/tax/Moadian/compliance center; 839 Python tests green at wave-end, 185 vitest, 28 Next.js routes). Spec: ~/workspace/user/files/design-eng_0_zaup.md (§10 events/mapping, §11 reports, §17 Phase 5 reshaped by ADR 0003, §18 nav, §19 rules). Standing rules: targeted tests per story (own + affected areas + ruff + pyright), full suite once at wave-end; DB-touching pytest stays SERIALIZED (shared Supabase test DB deadlocks on concurrent runs) — the Phase 4 phase-end full suite is STILL RUNNING as this plan is written; no DB-touching pytest until the parent confirms it finished. The 16-test Phase 4 architecture guard (no port bypass, no direct SQL to the Tryton DB) must stay green; no hard-coded rates or channel lists; Persian + Rial only. Exit criteria: the 5الف exit criteria in the phased design §1.2 (idempotency exactly-once, fail-closed review routing, draft-by-default + opt-in auto-post through the 3-layer gate, Toman→Rial at the connector boundary, channel registry with 7 rows + custom channel, review API returning all 9 item types, store order → Sale/invoice via the port).

acceptanceCriteria: Canonical event envelope per spec §10.2 with 15 fields + schema versioning (schema_version=1 for new events)
Transactional inbox/outbox + worker with a database poller (Procrastinate — MIT, Postgres-native, no Redis)
Three idempotency uniqueness constraints per spec §10.4 + concurrent-duplicate lock + idempotency-key TTL; same key + different hash returns 409 Conflict
§10.3 pipeline implemented end-to-end: verify → inbox store → normalize → map → draft → validate → policy gate → post-or-draft → retry / dead-letter queue (DLQ)
Manual DLQ replay from the UI (same idempotency key — no duplicate effect)
Inbox staleness alert (inbox stuck longer than N hours)
Automation decision audit log (policy/mapping version recorded for every auto-post/draft decision)
Toman→Rial (×10) conversion at the connector boundary, explicit and tested + per-store 'store prices are in Toman' setting; inside the system everything is whole Rial
Unit + integration tests green; ruff clean, pyright 0 errors; architecture guards green
userStories.description: As the platform I want a canonical event platform (envelope, inbox/outbox, idempotency, DLQ, audit log) so every store/gateway/bank event flows through one verified, exactly-once pipeline.
userStories.notes: F1 — Event platform. Prerequisite for all other streams; its envelope contract is fixed in the phased design §2 so F3/F4 can build against the spec in parallel and integrate when F1 lands.
userStories.title: Event platform: canonical envelope, inbox/outbox, idempotency, DLQ

acceptanceCriteria: Tryton 8.2 sale family installed (NOT rewritten): sale, sale_shipment_cost, sale_payment, sale_discount, sale_amendment, sale_invoice_grouping
account_payment_clearing, account_dunning + account_dunning_fee installed (installments/late fees)
stock, stock_supply, purchase_request, stock_package, stock_shipment_cost, carrier, account_stock_landed_cost, analytic_account + analytic_sale installed (prerequisite for phase 5چ)
account_statement + account_statement_rule installed (prerequisite for phases 5ت and 5چ)
AccountingEnginePort extended: sale/invoice/payment/credit-note — through the port only (Phase 4 port-bypass lesson; 16-test architecture guard must stay green)

§3.8 Tryton spikes closed BEFORE building on them: (1) payment wizards (Process/Succeed with clearing date) reachable via REST or JSON-RPC only? (2) can the adapter set party=gateway and maturity_date=tranche due on each line? (3) amount_to_pay behavior with Draft payments? (4) does Pay Invoice keep Party=customer or can gateway Party be set? (if customer stays, path 2 — direct journal via the port — is preferred). Wizard-driven path 1 vs direct-journal path 2 chosen and documented after the spikes
Iranian chart extended with receivables/payables accounts and cheque memorandum accounts (in the Phase 2 chart-installer module) — prerequisite for C1
Inventory accounting method decided (continental vs anglo-saxon — which fits Iranian standards better) BEFORE installing account_stock_* (UNVERIFIED in research; decide and document)
Targeted tests green; ruff clean, pyright 0 errors; store order → Sale/invoice creatable via the port (no direct SQL)
userStories.description: As the platform I want the Tryton sale/stock/statement/clearing/dunning modules installed and the engine port extended, so orders, payments and shipments flow through Tryton instead of being rebuilt.
userStories.notes: F2 — Tryton modules. Fully parallel with F1. Uses the Supabase Tryton DB (hesabyar_tryton_test) via trytond :8010; module installs must be recorded so they are repeatable on a fresh DB.
userStories.title: Tryton modules: sale/stock/statement/clearing/dunning + port extension

acceptanceCriteria: Configurable payment-channel registry (ADR 0003 item 12): built-in channels (ZarinPal, Sadad, Snapp Pay, DigiPay, Torob Pay, SalamPay, …) enable/disable/select per installation + MANUAL custom channel (name, settlement model, fee %, payment window); no channel list is hard-coded anywhere (grep-verified); Ilmaz is NOT in the built-in list

Versioned gateway_contract (fee %, settlement model tranche_legs, payment window, deadlines, tolerances, auto-post policy); a rate change creates a NEW version with an effective date; history is never rewritten
Mapping center (spec §10.5): per-gateway customer/product/account/journal mapping + mapping versioning + mapping suggestions (Suggest → Auto)
Three-layer policy gate (event type + amount cap + fiscal-period lock) + period-close lock + auto-post amount cap; proven in tests (unauthorized / over-cap / closed-period events never auto-post)
Bank-connection registry (per-company encrypted credentials) + store registry (scoped read-only API key per store)

Iranian official-holiday list (configurable at installation level, Friday as default weekly holiday); no verified holiday API was found — until a source is chosen, the matching window uses calendar days instead of 'business days'

REST endpoints (versioned /api/v1, RFC 9457 errors, API-key scopes): channel registry CRUD, contract versions, mappings, policy gate config; OpenAPI updated; unit + integration tests green; ruff clean, pyright 0 errors
userStories.description: As an operator I want payment channels, contracts, mappings and the auto-post policy gate as configurable registries, so nothing about a gateway or a rate is ever hard-coded.
userStories.notes: F3 — Registries & policy gate. Needs the F1 event envelope for event mapping — build against the envelope spec in the phased design §2 in parallel; integrate with F1's implementation when it lands.
userStories.title: Registries + policy gate: channels, contracts, mapping center, 3-layer gate

acceptanceCriteria: Uniform ReviewItem data model: id, type, severity, source_event_ref, reason, suggested_action, amount_irr, age + sla_deadline, actions[], assignee, audit[]
All 9 item types (full list in phased design §7.2) with permitted actions per type
Review-queue API + page with filters (type, severity, amount, age, channel/gateway) + default sort (critical first, then oldest)
Per-type counters for the dashboard + ageing/SLA alerts (configurable per type) + admin notification for a critical item past SLA

Dashboard page goes through BFF routes (no direct browser-to-backend, no browser-held credentials — standing Phase 3 pattern); VibeFarsi/FarsiUI components via the existing facade; Persian-only, RTL-first, light theme

API returns all 9 item types in tests (one sample item per type); responsive + a11y pass (390px/320px + desktop, keyboard navigation, contrast AA, no horizontal overflow); vitest green; tsc 0, lint clean, build green
Python: ruff clean, pyright 0 errors; architecture guards green
userStories.description: As an accountant I want one review queue for every exception type, so nothing from any module waits in a separate place.
userStories.notes: F4 — Review-queue skeleton. Needs the F1 decision audit log — build the skeleton + API + page against the spec in parallel; wire the audit log when F1 lands. This is the skeleton for phase 5ح (unified panel), which completes as each module lands.
userStories.title: Review-queue skeleton: uniform model, 9 types, API + page
